name: TimePicker
purpose: Enter a time of day via a field that opens a three-column time selector.
intent: A read-only time field (Text Field trigger) that opens hours / minutes / AM-PM listboxes in a Popup, with Cancel / Confirm.

figmaSource.variants: context (default | inline) x size (sm | md | lg) x state (default | filled | hover | open | disabled)

parts.trigger: figma-parts / select-trigger wrapping a text-field (time text + elemAfterInput clock icon 'picker_time', 16px in a 24x24 box).
parts.popup: the open state renders a popup > panelSurface > columns of code-parts/<menu-item> (selected = background/selected/default/default + content/selected) + a footer-item (a button-group with Cancel/Confirm buttons, tone=subtle, size=xs), each column with its own scrollbar.

figmaSource.notes: context default -> Text Field appearance 'default'; inline -> 'subtle'. The open state pins the field focus treatment (data-force-state='focus'). In code the popup uses the Popup primitive with three custom listbox columns (role=listbox/option) rather than the Menu organism, since selection is staged. While open the field previews the staged selection live; Confirm or an outside click commits, Cancel or Escape discards. Native scrollbars are used instead of Figma's custom scrollbar chrome. 12-hour with an AM/PM column (24-hour is a future addition).

useCases: a time-of-day field in a form
antiPatterns: picking a date (use Date Picker / Date-Time Picker)

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: wrapper; defaults to a 240px field width, shrinks to its container

anatomy.name: trigger
anatomy.description: read-only time display + trailing clock icon; aria-haspopup=dialog

anatomy.name: columns
anatomy.description: hours / minutes / AM-PM; roving tabindex; selected option highlighted

anatomy.name: footer
anatomy.description: Cancel + Confirm buttons; changes are staged until Confirm

accessibility.expanded: aria-expanded + aria-controls set by Popup while open
accessibility.columns: role=listbox with role=option children; aria-selected on the chosen option; roving tabindex
accessibility.keyboard: ArrowUp/ArrowDown + Home/End within a column; Tab between columns; Escape / Cancel discard and close; Confirm or an outside click commits
accessibility.focus: shared Focus Ring; opening moves focus to the selected hour

keyboardInteraction: ArrowUp / ArrowDown move the selection within a column; Home / End jump to the first / last option.
Tab moves between the hours, minutes, and AM/PM columns.
Escape discards the staged change, closes the popup, and returns focus to the field.
Confirm commits the staged time; Cancel discards it.
behaviorRules: Render a read-only Text Field showing the formatted time + a clock icon.
context maps to Text Field appearance (default -> default, inline -> subtle); size passes through.
Open a Popup with three listbox columns (hours 12-hour, minutes by minuteStep, AM/PM).
Preview the staged selection live in the field while open.
Commit the staged selection on Confirm or an outside click (onChange + close); discard it on Cancel or Escape (close).
Snap the incoming value's minute to the nearest step for the initial selection.
Controlled/uncontrolled value and open; do not open when disabled.
compositionRules: Compose the Text Field molecule (trigger), the Popup primitive, and the Button atom (footer).
Give the field an accessible name.
contentRules: Format the time with `format` / `locale`; provide a placeholder for the empty state.
Keep the footer button labels short.
responsiveRules: The field defaults to 240px and shrinks to its container.
The popup is a fixed 240px panel of three equal columns; each column scrolls independently.
themeRules: Field, popup, and options use semantic tokens; do not reference primitives directly.
Dark theme is supported through the generated token variables.
implementationNotes: React and TypeScript; React.forwardRef on the root.
CSS Modules; compose Text Field + Popup + Button; custom listbox columns (not the Menu organism).
Value carried on a Date (h:m) for clean composition into a Date/Time Picker.
12-hour with AM/PM (24-hour is a future addition); native scrollbars.
No MUI, no Tailwind, no hardcoded colors/typography/spacing.
do: Use for time-of-day entry in forms and filters.
Give the field an accessible name and a placeholder.
Set minuteStep to match the granularity you need.
Use inline context on dense or borderless surfaces.
dont: Use for date selection (use Date Picker).
acceptanceCriteria: Renders a field with the formatted time and a closed popup; placeholder when empty.
Opens three columns with the current time selected.
Previews the staged selection live in the field; Confirm or an outside click commits; Cancel or Escape discards.
Moves focus into the columns on open; closes on Escape returning focus.
Does not use MUI or Tailwind.
